name: lora-llm
description: LoRA fine-tune for instruction-following LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen — 7B to 32B). Uses QLoRA (4-bit) by default for VRAM efficiency.
pipDeps: huggingface-hub hf_xet hf_transfer torch transformers peft bitsandbytes trl datasets accelerate safetensors
notes: QLoRA 4-bit default for 24GB VRAM (7B-32B). Full LoRA requires 2x more VRAM. r=16, alpha=32 is good starting point. LR 2e-4 for 4-bit, 1e-4 for full. 3 epochs typical for instruction following.

smokeVerify.pythonInline:
import glob, torch
from peft import PeftModel
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
ckpts = sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/checkpoints/checkpoint-*'))
assert ckpts, 'no checkpoints found'
print('[smoke-verify] checkpoint:', ckpts[-1])
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ckpts[-1])
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(ckpts[-1], torch_dtype=torch.float16, device_map='auto')
out = model.generate(**tok('Hello', return_tensors='pt').to(model.device), max_new_tokens=20)
reply = tok.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
assert len(reply) > 5
print('[smoke-verify] OK —', repr(reply[:80]))
